{{Quote|The true attack&mdash;the one on Fel&mdash;is going to look like a diversion.''"<br />"''There's going to be ''another''?''"<br />"''Against the Solos. And they'll believe that ''they're'' the true targets.|Drikl Lecersen and Haydnat Treen, discussing Operation Duusha|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
'''Operation Duusha''' was organized by [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] in an attempt to advance his conspiracy with [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]] to take over control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Lecersen learned that Imperial [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] was going to dine with members of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] at the [[Pangalactus]] restaurant on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He enlisted [[Kester Tolann]], a reactionary [[Gender/Legends|man]] who was strongly opposed to Fel, to attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Fel. However, Lecersen knew that the attempt would almost certainly fail, and thus orchestrated it in hopes of reducing public sentiment toward Fel and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], helping to clear the way for his and Treen's rise to rulers of the galaxy.

When Fel and the Solos arrived at Pangalactus, Fel learned that Daala knew of their meeting and demanded to dine in a different room. Meanwhile, Tolann received the signal to attack, which was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] in watching recreated [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] in the room next to Fel's and barged into their room. However, before he could pull off his assassination&mdash;in which he was to committ suicide by triggering a detonator attached to his body&mdash;he was shot [[Death/Legends|dead]] by Fel's [[Imperial Security (Imperial Remnant)|security]] personnel. Two [[YVH-Series battle droid]]s then entered and attacked the group, although they, too, were defeated, with no casualties.

Despite the fact that neither Fel nor any of the Solos had been killed, Lecersen considered Operation Duusha to be a success. The Jedi Order, the Solos, and Fel suspected that Daala might have been behind the attack, and Fel guessed that Daala and one of the Moffs had conspired against him.
